adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the calendar update is performed via `const credentials = await getUsersCredentials(ctx.user);` and `new EventManager({ ...user, credentials: [...credentials] })` where `user` is the current session user (could be an attendee) rather than the booking organizer (`booking.userId` / `organizer` fetched earlier). Since `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` likely needs the organizer’s calendar credentials to update the event on the organizer/destination calendar, using the attendee’s credentials can cause the update to fail or not affect the organizer’s calendar when a non-organizer adds guests.
